## Where I am

Staging analytics RDS is set up for the PostgreSQL 17.2 blue/green upgrade in draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 (commits 9d41c0e, a2b7f55, c58e1fa). The postgres17 parameter group and blue/green update are in place, and the AWS provider is pinned to 5.82. Nothing has been applied, and prod is prepared but disabled. Remaining: the pg_partman upgrade on staging and a production window.

- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 to 5.x on staging (ALTER EXTENSION on 16.4), then check run_maintenance_proc on events_raw and events_daily.
- [essai-raté] terraform init failed on the lock file. The -upgrade run pulled AWS provider v6.4.0, which produced 37 changes, so it was rejected.
- [question] Prod window: it must avoid the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC), and Maya's sign-off is pending.
- [décision] Plan only, nothing applied; staging first. (source: t01)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to ~> 5.82.0, no v6 in this PR. (source: t04)
- [décision] No prod date before Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false. (source: t14)
